record.question: The minimum age to become a member of Lok Sabha is:
record.explanation: Answer C: 25 years. Article 84(b) requires a Lok Sabha candidate to be at least 25 years old. Reference: https://legislative.gov.in/constitution-of-india/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
